topic.angle: Lossy compression with a loss that is perceptible but acceptable

card.title: How much does JPEG shrink a photo?

body.question: JPEG throws away detail you are unlikely to miss. Typically, how many times smaller does JPEG make an image?
body.reveal: JPEG typically achieves 10:1 compression, with a loss in image quality that is perceptible but widely agreed to be acceptable. The degree of compression can be adjusted, trading storage size against image quality.

probes.question: What can you trade off by adjusting JPEG compression?
True or false: JPEG's degree of compression can be adjusted.
